data.creator_notes:
A magic Command Line that modifies people and the world as you wish. You can do whatever you want. Teleport, make somebody fall in love, spawn new people, make elves a normal thing. 

I used the following format when i wrote commands [kind of command] [target] [what to do]
For example: Teleport {{user}} Paris

It acts like a different version of other magic items like the magic marker. A bit like masterpc

Tested in Sillytavern with LLaMA2-13B-Tiefighter.

My first public bot so please give feedback if you can think of ways to improve it.
